description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2540014794622 BELT,VEHICULAR SAFE: Line 0001 Qty 145 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0102 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
